_comment: Example args for the design/build/film-review/gate workflows, filled with the real Leapcast values. Copy, then replace product/music/screens/angles for the next product. <scratch> = THIS session's scratchpad: re-clone the skill library each session (SKILL step 0.3). browser = the HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH exported in SKILL step 0.5. harness = <args.project>/tools/preview-frame.mjs as an absolute path (tools/ copied in step 0.6). product.theme = 'dark' | 'light' (the film's ground). music.bed = make-audio --out; music.bed_lufs = integrated LUFS of the bed (SKILL step 1, Music). frames = contents of .hyperframes/frames.json (node <skill>/tools/frames-json.mjs STORYBOARD.md). film-review adds render; gate adds current/previous/changes/complaints/polish.

product.name: Leapcast
product.what: a browser-based meeting workspace that turns every live conversation into summaries, decisions, action items, searchable knowledge and follow-through.
product.assistant: Ori (pink #FC097F S-curved hourglass mark; pink ONLY on Ori)
product.message: Meetings that keep working after the call
product.endcard: the leapcast wordmark lockup + beta tag, "Meetings that keep working after the call", leapcast.ai, "From $5/month · 240 AI minutes included"
product.brand_rules: Terracotta #D73D13 is the ONLY accent (punches), #C96442 for UI/wordmark, #D97F60 tint; Ori pink #FC097F only on Ori; canvas #0C0B0E; never purple/blue AI gradients; Schibsted Grotesk headlines, Inter UI.
product.design_notes: canvas/bg #0C0B0E, surface #17191A, card #202124, raised #262624, hairline rgba(255,255,255,.10), text #F4F4F5, text-muted #C3C0B6, text-dim ~55% white, terracotta #D73D13 / soft #C96442 / tint #D97F60 / glow 14%, ori-pink #FC097F + ori-glow, success #3FA65A, record-red #E5484D. Fonts: assets/fonts/InterVariable.woff2 (100 900), InterVariable-Italic.woff2, SchibstedGrotesk-latin.woff2 (400 900). The wordmark SVG ships cream fills — recolor to #C96442.
product.continuity: F1/F12 bookend (same room-card framing + glow), tile outlines F2→F3→F4, the room world F5→F6 (no visible cut), the lost action-item ghosts (F3 vanish points = F8 start points)

music.name: Mixkit "Deep Urban" (id 623, free license)
music.energy: quiet 0–5 s, builds 5–15 s, full energy from the bar-8 drop (15.48 s) to the end

angles.brief: ANGLE 1 — Statement-led (Linear-style). Big display statements on near-black carry the film; each claim is proved by a real product shot that pushes in / masks / parallaxes under it. Ends on the wordmark lockup.

ANGLE 2 — Product-led camera journey. One continuous dark world of real screens; the camera dives through the live room, into the assistant, out to the post-meeting outputs, library and analytics. Copy is small eyebrows and one big line at the drop.
ANGLE 3 — Before/after. Dramatize the problem first (a meeting ends, everything said scatters and fades), flip it at the drop with the product, then the outputs cascade. Close with pricing + CTA.
